baseScenarioSnapshots.title: Courier Crossing
baseScenarioSnapshots.subtitle: A parcel route, an uncertain crossing, a promise.
baseScenarioSnapshots.brief: Two couriers must complete a long delivery route before the gate closes. The shortcut carries greater exposure to uncertain conditions; the careful route yields less progress. Plan repeated rests and meals from six shared rations; inspection also costs time.

baseScenarioSnapshots.title: Water Commons
baseScenarioSnapshots.subtitle: A shared supply that is used as it is replenished.
baseScenarioSnapshots.brief: Two neighbors replenish a shared water store over a long work period. The settlement uses half a unit each round. Faster collection is more exposed to uncertain conditions. Six shared rations and repeated rest support the sustained task.

baseScenarioSnapshots.subtitle: One person, a small repair, no social effects.
baseScenarioSnapshots.brief: Finish a sustained repair on your own before the work period ends. Alternate work with recovery and meals from three rations; the deadline leaves room for unsuccessful attempts. There are no partners, promises or assistance effects.

design.changed: Only scenario.horizon in the sweep; all targets, bodies, skills, actions, costs, rations, hazard and core physics unchanged.
design.confirmation: Solo horizon24 selected from the sweep and rerun on another fixed100-seed block. This is simulation confirmation, not human validation or a general success guarantee.
design.interruptionCost: Not implemented or simulated. The0.2 forced-rest and complete automatic-meal behavior remains unchanged.

plannedController.scope: Solo only. It controls the sole actor through current manual commands; state.options.policy remains baseline.
plannedController.inputs: getView(state, actorId): rounded perceived body, available food, known actions and baseline rankActions(view). No seed, hidden hazard or future draw is read.
definition: If observed hunger >=0.60 and world.food >0, request eat.
Otherwise if observed fatigue >=0.65, request rest.
Otherwise request the highest-ranked work action from unchanged baseline rankActions(view), retaining its existing output/proficiency utility and tie-break.
Advance once with step(state,{type:"act",actorId,actionId}); repeat while running.
plannedController.twoPersonLimit: The current manual command directs one actor only. A faithful same-controller two-person comparison needs a policy-provider extension; the two-person sweep compares existing full and baseline only.

interpretation.preferredNextExperiment: Keep36-round forgiving presets. Consider an optional24-round Solo pressure workload before changing physical recovery. Planned-simple and full already outperform greedy under this budget; neither is universally best.
negativeFindings: At18 Solo rounds, greedy wins17/100, planned14/100, full11/100.
At24 Commons rounds seed7, greedy wins45/45 while full loses42/45.
Near-universal success at36 rounds is a forgiving-workload ceiling; it does not imply equivalent decision quality.
interpretation.uncertainty: Confirmation intervals are paired mean binary-success differences ±1.96 sample paired standard error; descriptive Monte Carlo variability only, exploratory and unadjusted for multiple comparisons.
pendingCostAcceptance: If an interruption-time mechanism is considered, specify exactly which recovery interval it reduces and preserve maintenance, nonnegative duration and full-ration accounting.
A zero-cost control should reproduce0.2 nonprose execution outcomes exactly.
Evaluate0/2/5/10min costs within20min rounds with normal and pressure budgets; report all results rather than selecting the cost that makes full win.
Require the stronger simple planned controller to benefit relative to greedy, not only full. Preserve feasible manual play with some failed-attempt slack.
Removing automatic meals is a separate intervention: greedy never elects food, so permanent hunger-blocking would be a trivial comparison.
